fullPassage: [P01] Restricting power has been one of the great achievements of human culture. Even in groups of animals, the leader can do almost anything he (or less often she) wants. Humans have gradually learned to hold their leaders responsible. The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their will. Even in the family, the husband or father no longer holds the extreme power over his wife and children that was common in many earlier societies, a power that at times has extended to life and death. As a result, the rate of marriage continues to decline and women continue to have their first child at older ages. Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to restrict and restrain the uses of power. [P02] Intuition is an imaginative way of perceiving the world around you. While your five senses see factual detail, your intuition sees the nuances or shades of meaning. For intuitives, the world is full of possibilities, and exploring new ideas, people, places, and things is what gives life its zest. They love to seek what's possible in the future; they aim to understand whole systems rather than just the parts. This is the aptitude used by scientists to raise new questions and think outside the box. Good scientists, however, must not tell by intuition which theories will turn out the best before the evidence appears. Poets employ intuition to create metaphors and playfully manipulate the commonsense meaning of words. Actors use it to imagine the inner life and motives of the characters they portray. [P03] Many international negotiations demonstrate that the stronger side should not take its power for granted but rather should analyze it carefully. In particular, it should ask what its sources of power are in this specific negotiation rather than merely calculating its total resources. Had the United States objectively examined this question at the outset of the conflict in Vietnam, the country might not have wasted the men and resources that it did in the war. Some U.S. citizens believe that war is absolutely necessary to promote and maintain a democratic and peaceful world order. The failure of the strong to understand their power may also lead them to behave unwisely in a negotiation. Through words and actions, a party may communicate its power in arrogant ways, ways that provoke the hostility of the other side, make it defensive, and in the end hinder negotiation. [P04] Linguists today are much concerned over the loss of indigenous languages, as endangered tongues pass quietly from the scene when the few village elders still speaking them die. Already, youngsters in the community will be using a tongue with wider circulation, and no passionate campaign to save the fading language is mounted by locals. If such an effort is made, it is likely to come from outsiders aware of the particular significance or value of the syntax, grammar, or vocabulary as these relate to the ecological setting of a language, or the way the language reflects the worldviews of its speakers. We should keep in mind that learning a language is like stepping into an entirely new world, and it's going to take some time. The great majority of the languages being lost have never been written or recorded, but among them some are likely to contain crucial pieces of evidence concerning such matters as environmental change, early migration, ecology, and belief systems. A growing movement is under way to document such languages to the extent that research funds allow, but the accelerating rate of loss will render it inevitably incomplete.

✅ ④ help(돕는다)는 hinder(방해하다)의 반의어로, 오만한 태도가 적대감을 부르고 상대를 방어적으로 만든 뒤 협상을 '돕는다'고 하면 앞 내용과 모순됨 ←정답

Humans use laws—which are among the most powerful elements of culture—to restrict and restrain the uses of power. [P02] Intuition is an imaginative way of perceiving the world around you. While your five senses see factual detail, your intuition sees the nuances or shades of meaning. For intuitives, the world is full of possibilities, and exploring new ideas, people, places, and things is what gives life its zest. They love to seek what's possible in the future; they aim to understand whole systems rather than just the parts. This is the aptitude used by scientists to raise new questions and think outside the box. Good scientists, however, must not tell by intuition which theories will turn out the best before the evidence appears. Poets employ intuition to create metaphors and playfully manipulate the commonsense meaning of words. Actors use it to imagine the inner life and motives of the characters they portray. [P03] Many international negotiations demonstrate that the stronger side should not take its power for granted but rather should analyze it carefully. In particular, it should ask what its sources of power are in this specific negotiation rather than merely calculating its total resources. Had the United States objectively examined this question at the outset of the conflict in Vietnam, the country might not have wasted the men and resources that it did in the war. Some U.S. citizens believe that war is absolutely necessary to promote and maintain a democratic and peaceful world order. The failure of the strong to understand their power may also lead them to behave unwisely in a negotiation. Through words and actions, a party may communicate its power in arrogant ways, ways that provoke the hostility of the other side, make it defensive, and in the end hinder negotiation. [P04] Linguists today are much concerned over the loss of indigenous languages, as endangered tongues pass quietly from the scene when the few village elders still speaking them die. Already, youngsters in the community will be using a tongue with wider circulation, and no passionate campaign to save the fading language is mounted by locals. If such an effort is made, it is likely to come from outsiders aware of the particular significance or value of the syntax, grammar, or vocabulary as these relate to the ecological setting of a language, or the way the language reflects the worldviews of its speakers. We should keep in mind that learning a language is like stepping into an entirely new world, and it's going to take some time. The great majority of the languages being lost have never been written or recorded, but among them some are likely to contain crucial pieces of evidence concerning such matters as environmental change, early migration, ecology, and belief systems. A growing movement is under way to document such languages to the extent that research funds allow, but the accelerating rate of loss will render it inevitably incomplete.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 decline과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: decline = 감소하다, 줄어들다

✅ ② increase(증가하다)는 decline(감소하다)의 반의어로 가장 반대되는 뜻 ←정답
❌ ③ drop(떨어지다)은 decline과 유사한 의미
❌ ④ weaken(약화되다)은 세력이 줄어드는 방향이라 decline과 결이 비슷함
det.tip: decline(감소하다) ↔ increase(증가하다). 결혼율이 계속 감소한다(continues to decline).

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 extreme과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: extreme = 극단적인, 과도한
det.analysis:
❌ ① intense(강렬한)는 extreme과 유사한 정도의 세기를 나타냄
❌ ② severe(심한)는 extreme과 유사한 의미
❌ ③ common(흔한)은 빈도를 뜻해 정도의 세기와 다른 축이며 반의어가 아님
✅ ④ moderate(적당한/온건한)는 extreme(극단적인)의 반의어로 가장 반대되는 뜻 ←정답
det.tip: extreme(극단적인) ↔ moderate(온건한/적당한). 과거 사회에서 가장은 극단적인(extreme) 권력을 가졌다.

questions.passage:
(A) The progress of culture has included imposing more and more restrictions on power, so that even the topmost leaders can be arrested, put on trial, and removed from office against their <u>will</u>.

(B) Already, youngsters in the community <u>will</u> be using a tongue with wider circulation, and no passionate campaign to save the fading language is mounted by locals.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 (A)의 밑줄 친 will과 (B)의 will의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) against their will = 그들의 의지에 반하여 (명사: 의지) (B) will be using = ~하고 있을 것이다 (미래 조동사)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A)의 '유언'은 재산 처분 문서를 뜻해 '자리에서 물러나게 되는 의지에 반하여'라는 문맥과 맞지 않음
❌ ② (B)의 '의지'는 will be using에서 조동사 역할과 맞지 않음
✅ ③ (A) will은 명사 '의지' = against their will(그들의 의지에 반하여), (B) will은 미래 조동사 '~할 것이다' = will be using(사용하고 있을 것이다)으로 가장 적절 ←정답
❌ ④ (A) '유언', (B) '원하다' 모두 문맥에 맞지 않음
det.tip: will: (A) 명사 = 의지(volition), against one's will = 의지에 반하여. (B) 조동사 = 미래를 나타내는 ~할 것이다.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to understand or know something immediately, without the need for conscious reasoning"

det.korean: 의식적인 추론 없이 무언가를 즉시 이해하거나 아는 능력
det.analysis:
✅ ① intuition(직관)은 '의식적 추론 없이 즉시 이해하는 능력'이라는 정의에 정확히 맞음 ←정답
❌ ② negotiation(협상)은 합의를 위한 논의로, 즉각적 앎의 능력과 다름
❌ ③ circulation(유통/순환)은 널리 퍼져 도는 것으로, 이해 능력과 무관
❌ ④ aptitude(적성/재능)는 특정 분야의 소질로, 즉각적 직관과는 다른 개념
det.tip: intuition = 직관. 오감의 사실적 정보와 달리 의미의 뉘앙스를 즉시 알아채는 능력.

questions.passage: The __________ (fail) of the strong to understand their power may also lead them to behave unwisely in a negotiation. Through words and actions, a party may communicate its power in arrogant ways, ways that provoke the hostility of the other side.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 강자가 자신의 힘을 이해하지 못하는 것은 협상에서 그들이 현명하지 못하게 행동하도록 이끌 수도 있다.
det.analysis: 동사 fail(실패하다)을 명사 failure(실패, ~하지 못함)로 바꿔야 한다. 빈칸 뒤 of the strong의 수식을 받으며 주어 자리에 오므로 명사형이 필요하다. 'The failure of the strong to understand'는 '강자가 이해하지 못하는 것'이라는 명사구를 이룬다.
det.tip: fail(동사) → failure(명사). 주어 자리에는 명사형이 온다. failure to+동사원형 = ~하지 못함.

questions.passage: The great majority of the languages being lost have never been written or recorded, but among them some are likely to contain crucial pieces of evidence. A growing movement is under way to document such languages, but the accelerating rate of loss will render it __________ (inevitable) incomplete.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 그런 언어를 기록하려는 움직임이 커지고 있지만, 가속화되는 손실 속도가 그 작업을 필연적으로 불완전하게 만들 것이다.
det.analysis: 형용사 inevitable(필연적인)을 부사 inevitably(필연적으로)로 바꿔야 한다. 빈칸은 뒤의 형용사 incomplete(불완전한)를 수식하는 자리이므로 형용사가 아니라 부사가 와야 한다. 'render it inevitably incomplete' = 그것을 필연적으로 불완전하게 만들다.
det.tip: inevitable(형용사) → inevitably(부사). 형용사/동사를 수식할 때는 부사(-ly) 형태를 쓴다. 여기서는 형용사 incomplete를 수식.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이것은 과학자들이 새로운 질문을 던지고 틀에서 벗어나 생각하기 위해 사용하는 능력이다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① inside the lines(선 안에서)는 정해진 틀을 지킨다는 뜻으로, 새 질문을 던진다는 문맥과 반대
✅ ② outside the box(틀을 벗어나)는 'raise new questions(새 질문을 던지다)'와 어울려 창의적·혁신적 사고를 뜻함 ←정답

❌ ④ without evidence(증거 없이)는 뒷문장의 '증거가 나타나기 전' 내용과 혼동을 주며 빈칸 문맥에 맞지 않음
det.tip: think outside the box = 고정관념(틀)에서 벗어나 생각하다. 직관은 새 질문을 던지고 틀을 깨는 데 쓰인다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 많은 국제 협상은 더 강한 쪽이 자신의 힘을 당연시하지 말고 신중하게 분석해야 함을 보여 준다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① increase its military strength(군사력을 키우다)는 힘을 분석하라는 문맥과 초점이 다름
❌ ② reveal its hidden weakness(숨은 약점을 드러내다)는 본문에서 다루지 않은 내용
❌ ③ avoid all forms of conflict(모든 갈등을 피하다)는 힘의 원천을 분석하라는 문맥과 무관
✅ ④ take its power for granted(자신의 힘을 당연시하다)는 'should not ~ but rather should analyze it carefully(당연시하지 말고 신중히 분석하라)'라는 대조 구조에 정확히 맞음 ←정답
det.tip: take ~ for granted = ~을 당연시하다. 강자는 힘을 당연시하지 말고(should not take for granted) 신중히 분석해야 한다.
